title: Executable market data governance: artifact and validation harness
description:
The analysed file set and the V1-V5 validation harness accompanying the article "Market Data Governance as Knowledge Management: Managing Temporality via Rule Versioning, Provenance, and Auditability" (VINE Journal of Information and Knowledge Management Systems, Emerald Publishing, 2026).

It contains exactly the modules, configuration and fixtures the article's claims depend on, a harness that reproduces the five artifact-level validations reported in the article, and a report mapping each claim to the file and line range that evidences it. All data are synthetic, generated deterministically with a fixed seed. This is a simulated research artifact, not a trading system.
